releaseNotes:
• Pure Sinhala Phonetic Precision: Standardized Sinhala Singlish phonetic typing without dictionary overwrite on space; fixed capital I to ඊ/ී, Aa to ඈ/ෑ, ndh to ඳ, ng to ඟ
• Scroll Preservation & Auto-Centering in Emoji & Symbols: Category ribbon smoothly centers selected tab and never snaps back to beginning
• Massive Kaomoji Collection: Added 100+ cute and popular Japanese kaomojis across multiple categories
• Reliable Background Auto-Update Notifications: Screen unlock and power broadcast triggers with AlarmManager setAndAllowWhileIdle for alerts without opening app
• Smart English Auto-Capitalization: Keyboard automatically opens capitalized for English sentence start without affecting Sinhala
• WhatsApp & WA Business Status Saver: Auto-detects statuses without manual folder access, saves into separate WhatsApp & WhatsApp Business folders with redesigned neon action buttons
• Auto Crash Diagnostic Prompt: Proactive bug detection and 1-tap reporting
